why: The final main-sequence rerun, on Ledoux (PI 2026-11-25): the 49 4D ladder stars and ours' seven OPAL tracks, grav=1, the stirred core taking only layers within 0.02 in hydrogen of its mean (a core no longer regrows into the gradient it left), ε_grav re-solved off where it fails a step, resumes under KHMIN, ours at khmin=0.1. Tagged v3, fresh files; each command resumes its own checkpoint on later legs. Spare slots (ev27s-*): the Schwarzschild set (evolve4-26, tag v2) continued as the boundary criterion comparison: its 22 unfinished 4D tracks, the solver stops resuming on the ε_grav fallback; G 1e-17 s 1.65 2.0 M_Ch left out (its core runs away under Schwarzschild).
